response.sql: WITH status_averages AS (SELECT s.entrystat AS status, AVG(e.ambictemp) AS avg_ambient_temperature, AVG(e.imgcount) AS avg_images FROM scanenvironment AS e JOIN sites AS s ON e.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.entrystat) SELECT status, avg_ambient_temperature, avg_images, avg_images - AVG(avg_images) OVER () AS image_average_difference FROM status_averages
